The Supreme Court temporarily restored access to mifepristone. But the truth remains that we shouldn't be one court ruling away from millions of people losing access to safe, effective medication.

I won’t stop fighting until modern reproductive healthcare is restored.

In the days before the U.S. bombed Iran, some traders placed perfectly-timed bets on the outcome—some accounts won millions.

Was that just luck? Looks like insider trading to me.

theguardian.com/world/2026/a…

Why would the President try to take over the Fed? The answer is simple—the economy is a mess.

His plan is to seize control of the Fed, create chaos around it, and then juice the economy just enough to carry him through the midterm elections.

We see right through it.

Trump claims that gas prices are "lower than they could be."

This is his way to spin the war he started. Saying that you could have it worse.

I'm not sure the families who are paying about $70 to fill up their tanks find that comforting.

The Paramount-Warner Bros. merger consolidates power, crushes workers, and squeezes consumers.

When one company controls what stories are told and what news is reported—that's not just bad business. That's dangerous for democracy.

Nearly 2/3 of abortions in America are medication abortions.

1/4 are prescribed via telemedicine.

The far-right's focus on banning receiving mifepristone by mail is part of their goal to ban abortion access everywhere.

I asked RFK Jr. about TrumpRx's claim of "600% drug price reductions." His answer? Trump has a "different way of calculating percentages."

Nope —TrumpRx is a scam.

Americans are using Buy Now Pay Later options to pay for needs like groceries or medical care.

54% of users said they couldn’t make ends meet without these loans.

Nearly half of users in the last year were late at least once—compared to 34% in 2024.

This is Trump's economy.

75% of Americans now say the economy is "poor." 

No matter how much Trump goes on Fox News to try to gaslight consumers about his economy, the pain people are feeling is real.

pbs.org/newshour/politics/ap…

Trump promised to lower gas prices. Instead, he started a war with Iran that sent oil to over $4 a gallon—and increasing every day. 

Working families are paying the price for Trump’s war.

Did you know that Donald Trump could appoint two more Supreme Court Justices?

Video

Happy birthday to our Bailey. Eight years of golden retriever energy and unconditional love. 

You've walked the campaign trail, stolen every selfie, and reminded us every single day what really matters the most—burritos.

What we're really seeing in Iran is another forever war. A war with no obvious end.

Donald Trump has demonstrated over and over and over that he has no plan and no exit ramp.

Republicans in Congress must act.

The Paramount-Warner Bros merger reeks of corruption.

Trump said he would be “personally involved" in the transaction.

He said he wanted Netflix & Paramount “to compete for his approval.”

He reportedly shared “implicit support” for Paramount’s bid. 

I'm sounding the alarm.

13 Americans have been killed, and hundreds more are injured.

We’re spending $1 billion in taxpayer funds a day.

Gas is more than $4 per gallon.

This is the cost of Trump's war.

My thoughts on the Melania movie.
Why is Donald Trump claiming TrumpRx is decreasing drug costs by 600%?
Americans can't afford Trump's war with Iran.
Republicans voted to let Trump's war with Iran continue FIVE TIMES.
Why did Donald Trump fire these career diplomats before his war with Iran?
I just voted to end Donald Trump’s war with Iran.
If you watch The Pitt, you need to see this.
@Patty Murray and I are launching a working group to write legislation to deliver affordable child care for every family.
Why is “Peace Envoy” Jared Kushner trying to raise $5 BILLION for his private equity firm in the middle of a war with Iran?

What do ABC, Paramount, X, and Meta all have in common?  All of those companies settled lawsuits with Donald Trump by promising to donate millions of dollars to one of his presidential library funds. But then, something really weird happened.
